div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 驗齡及必要姓名核對通過

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 先看原備酒完整價金與酒商賣方

div.style: display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 主人決定？

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 保留全數購買明細

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 交回授權店員，只調整原酒款購買瓶數

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 確認取消；原簽名失效

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 整筆待酒商取回；不向主人加收取回費

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 酒商確認取回，服務未完成

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 各列瓶數為整數且未超過原備酒數？

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 提示並保留原明細

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 是否至少購買一瓶？

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 保存減量明細並重算；舊簽名與舊失敗資格失效

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 主人核對本次購買明細

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 本次明細有有效手寫簽名？

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 簽名確認購買，或清除重簽

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 現場模擬支付本次酒款與運送費

div.style: display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 付款成功？

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 本次購買服務完成；僅實購酒款計10%分潤

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 保留同版本簽名與付款失敗紀錄

div.style: display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 下一步？

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 交回店員確認本筆代收

div.style: display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 店員承接代收？

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 本次購買服務完成；全額代收帳款，僅實購計10%分潤

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 獲選酒商之後確認整筆收清

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 原成交與分潤不變，不重複記帳

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 本次是否有未購買酒品？

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 完成，無餘酒取回待辦

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 已購買部分完成；未購買部分依第三圖取回
